summary: Graviton (ARM) CPU inference routing is implemented for pytorch and tensorflow. Changes: (1) src/sagemaker/image_uri_config/pytorch.json and tensorflow.json each gained one sibling section, inference_graviton (cpu only, alias 1.12->1.12.1 / 2.9->2.9.1, py38, pytorch-inference-graviton / tensorflow-inference-graviton, ubuntu20.04, 26 registries); additions only. (2) src/sagemaker/fw_utils.py gained GRAVITON_ALLOWED_TARGET_INSTANCE_FAMILY = [c6g, t4g, r6g, m6g] and GRAVITON_ALLOWED_FRAMEWORKS = {pytorch, tensorflow}. (3) src/sagemaker/image_uris.py imports those constants, adds GRAVITON_INFERENCE_SCOPE, a private helper _get_image_scope called before config load in the non-HF branch, and a "-sagemaker" suffix applied when repo == f"{framework}-inference-graviton". (4) Tests: two module-scoped fixtures in tests/conftest.py (graviton_pytorch_version=1.12.1, graviton_tensorflow_version=2.9.1), graviton_framework_uri in tests/unit/sagemaker/image_uris/expected_uris.py, and new tests/unit/sagemaker/image_uris/test_graviton.py with test_graviton_pytorch and test_graviton_tensorflow (26 regions x 4 families). Results with PYTHONPATH pointing at the repo src (the venv's .pth otherwise imports the shared base copy): both new tests pass; test_dlc_frameworks.py 502 passed; image_uris directory excluding DLC 161 passed with jumpstart/ and test_retrieve.py uncollectable; with a stdlib mock shim in /tmp (outside repo, venv untouched) test_retrieve.py, jumpstart/, test_fw_utils.py 95 passed; test_pytorch.py and tensorflow test_estimator_init.py 1107 passed, 224 skipped. Unverified due to missing packages in the shared venv: test_image.py (yaml missing), other tensorflow estimator/tfs suites, huggingface and model_uris suites (mock missing), and lint (black/flake8 absent). Import order verified in fresh interpreters for fw_utils, image_uris, and package. Nothing committed. Shared machine had other runs' processes; none were killed.
